resales.note: Every resale of the world, with what the reseller paid and the freight the documents state, for the build check of decision D14 and open point O30 (tools/world_items.py): nobody resells below what they paid plus the stated freight and the import tax they bear, and a reseller's gross margin on the sale, (price - cost) / price, falls in the band for its kind of business (parties.json identity.legal.business), or for the kind of goods where a sale names one (band: clothing, whose margins are higher, O30), except during a promotion, when only the upper limit applies. A price agreed for the buyer (items.json buyer_prices) is the sale's price where it holds for the sale's delivery terms (terms). Freight the buyer pays on top at cost (recharged, a pass-through) is neither the reseller's cost nor part of its price. What the reseller paid is the price its seller asks it (items.json buyer_prices, else the seller's price). Freight is shared over the goods a transport carries by their gross weight. Prices before tax; amounts compared in lume at the reference rates. A sale listed under awaiting_owner fails the check for a reason the owner has still to decide.

goods_chain.note: The goods chain of the park bench (D21, open points O64 and O65): Valdara's production record and the stock ledgers of the warehouses its goods pass through. A lot is one day's production of benches, with its date and quantity; a spare side frame carries a serial number that rises with the day it was cast (the frames of a bench lot are in the same series). Each ledger lists what came in (with the import declaration under which it entered the country, where it crossed a border), what went out, and what passed through without entering the stock (a cross-dock). The documents take their lots, serials and manufacture dates from here; tools/world_items.py checks that stock never goes below zero, nothing leaves before it arrived or was made, damaged stock (damaged: a refused bench that came back) is held apart and never sold or despatched, and a ledger ends with the closing stock it states; the build checks each despatch against its entry (O174). Items are the maker's (world/items.json); a reseller's item is the maker's item it resells. Each casting day has its own melt number and pour time, and each bench lot its own coating batch (D21, worklist C70): both are numbered in a running count of the year.
